# QS-CFW-4516-94 - Quality specification - connecting rod CFW-4516-94 (1045) Rev B

Scope
This quality specification applies to connecting rod CFW-4516-94 produced at Plant P3. It defines the acceptance limits and inspection method for hardness, bore diameter, and forging weight for forged and finished deliveries of CFW-4516-94. Use this document for incoming, in-process, and final quality checks.

Requirements table

| Parameter | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material / Part | CFW-4516-94 |
| Hardness | 28-32 HRC |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.10 mm |
| Maximum forging weight | 28.4 kg |

Inspection method
Visual confirmation of part identity and absence of gross defects shall be performed before dimensional and hardness inspection. Hardness shall be measured using a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester at appropriate locations on the big end and small end according to engineering drawings for CFW-4516-94. Record hardness readings and verify compliance with 28-32 HRC. Bore diameter shall be inspected using calibrated bore measurement equipment; record measured values and verify conformance to ±0.10 mm relative to the nominal dimension shown on the drawing for CFW-4516-94. Weigh the forging on calibrated scales and verify the forging weight does not exceed 28.4 kg. All inspection instruments must be traceable to the laboratory standard and calibration records retained with inspection records.

Nonconformance handling
Nonconforming parts identified for hardness, bore diameter, or forging weight must be segregated and clearly tagged. Notify Quality and Production for disposition; acceptable dispositions include rework if permitted by engineering for CFW-4516-94 or scrap. A nonconformance record shall describe the condition, inspection data, and final disposition. Preventive actions and corrective actions shall be initiated when trend evidence or recurring nonconformance is identified for CFW-4516-94.
